notes: Dell OptiPlex 3040 ships in three chassis: Mini Tower (MT), Small Form Factor (SFF), and Micro. This entry documents the SFF/MT I/O configuration (identical port sets per Dell's official spec sheet); dimensions/bays differ but connectors do not. The Micro variant differs meaningfully: only 6 external USB ports (4x USB 3.0, 2x USB 2.0, no front USB 2.0), is powered by a 65W external AC adapter feeding a DC barrel input instead of an internal PSU/IEC inlet, and offers a factory-optional add-in serial+PS/2 adapter or a second DisplayPort 1.2 (mutually exclusive choice) — not modeled here. An internal-only USB 2.0 header (used for an optional internal wireless/Bluetooth card) was omitted as it is not an externally accessible port. Source is Dell's official Japanese-language OptiPlex 3040 data sheet hosted on i.dell.com (Dell's own asset CDN); content/specs are identical to the English data sheet, only the marketing copy is localized. Not rack-mountable (desktop/SFF form factor), so rackUnits omitted.
